proposed_comments.title: Clamp persisted preview-size values
proposed_comments.body:
### Clamp persisted preview-size values

**Severity:** `medium`

Please validate the persisted maximum-preview-size value when loading settings, not only when converting the value for a read. A hand-edited or older settings file can otherwise restore an invalid value and bypass the UI's intended bounds; clamp or reject it at the settings boundary and add coverage for invalid persisted values.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The upstream diff adds the preview-size setting and its read-time conversion, but it does not include the settings-load boundary where persisted values are restored; the required validation and regression test therefore have no safe current RIGHT-side anchor.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The required settings-boundary assertion and its regression case are not safely represented by one current upstream diff anchor.

confidence.rationale: The fork fix and its dedicated regression test directly demonstrate that persisted values can bypass the UI range unless the load boundary enforces the invariant.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve charset detection and BOM-less Unicode fallback
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve charset detection and BOM-less Unicode fallback

**Severity:** `high`

Please ensure the bounded read path does not make charset detection depend only on a short prefix: legacy encodings can become distinguishable after that prefix and then decode later characters incorrectly. The binary heuristic must also recognize plausible BOM-less UTF-16 and UTF-32 text before rejecting NUL-containing content, with regression coverage for both cases.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The requested correction spans bounded detector sampling, encoding classification, and multiple Unicode regression cases rather than one independently replaceable line in the current RIGHT-side diff, so no single safe inline anchor exists.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The finding spans the detector stream, text classification heuristic, and multiple encoding cases; no single current RIGHT-side range is a safe independently applicable replacement.

confidence.rationale: The issue was reproduced by successive fork Copilot passes and fixed with bounded full-stream detection plus explicit BOM-less Unicode tests.

proposed_comments.title: Make the memory-behavior documentation truthful
proposed_comments.body:
### Make the memory-behavior documentation truthful

**Severity:** `medium`

Please correct the comment that says the whole file is never held in memory at once. Decoding is chunked, but the complete decoded text is still accumulated for the downstream renderer, so the comment should describe the actual bounded-read and buffered-result behavior rather than implying constant-memory rendering.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The comment's accurate wording depends on the complete read-and-buffer contract across the new decoder path, not on one isolated changed line; anchoring a standalone documentation edit to the current RIGHT-side diff could misrepresent that contract.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: This is a documentation correction coupled to the read-path design and is not emitted as a standalone suggestion because the safe wording depends on the final buffering contract.

confidence.rationale: The implementation appends decoded chunks to a StringBuilder and materializes the complete result before rendering.

proposed_comments.title: Name the new NumberBox for screen readers
proposed_comments.body:
### Name the new NumberBox for screen readers

**Severity:** `medium`

Please bind `AutomationProperties.Name` on the new NumberBox to the existing maximum-preview-size header (following the accessibility pattern used by neighboring Settings controls). Without an accessible name, screen-reader users who tab to the field cannot identify what the value controls.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The requested accessibility property belongs on the new XAML control together with its associated header and the exact control anchor changed during review; without a stable current RIGHT-side range, an inline coordinate would risk targeting stale markup.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The exact XAML anchor moved during the fork review iterations; keep this as a coordinated accessibility request rather than risk a stale line-targeted suggestion.

confidence.rationale: The current control has no explicit accessible name, while the associated header already provides the correct user-facing label.

proposed_comments.title: Cover settings backward compatibility and round trips
proposed_comments.body:
### Cover settings backward compatibility and round trips

**Severity:** `medium`

Please add serialization coverage proving that an older settings document without the new property keeps the 10 MB default and that a configured value survives a JSON round trip. This protects existing users when the persisted Settings UI schema gains the new preview-size field.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The requested tests belong to the persisted Settings UI serialization contract and cover both legacy input and round-trip behavior; the current diff does not provide one safe RIGHT-side anchor for this multi-case coverage.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The coverage belongs with the persisted Settings UI schema and cannot be reduced to one safe inline replacement in the current PR diff.

confidence.rationale: The new persisted field changes the settings schema, and the requested cases directly cover missing-property compatibility and configured-value persistence.

proposed_comments.title: Keep end-to-end fallback coverage deterministic
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep end-to-end fallback coverage deterministic

**Severity:** `medium`

Please retain an integration-level test through the factory-to-preview fallback path for text, binary, and oversized files, and create the required Peek temporary directory explicitly so the test passes on a clean account. Unit tests alone do not prove that an unrecognized file reaches the intended preview or that binary and oversized inputs still take the information-preview path.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The request covers temporary-directory setup, factory routing, and three distinct fallback outcomes across the integration path; no single current RIGHT-side diff range can safely represent all required changes.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: This request covers setup and multiple factory outcomes, so it is intentionally a companion note rather than a multi-file inline patch.

confidence.rationale: The fork validation showed the clean-account setup requirement and exercised the three distinct fallback outcomes through the factory.
